objective: Validate the proven minimal SAME-MAIN self-update pattern in production control: full recurring VEVENT, enabled=true, provisional crash insurance before work, and exactly one authoritative final close write to observed close + 1 minute (60 seconds).
acceptance_criteria: Every scheduler mutation uses the SAME MAIN canonical with full VEVENT DTSTART plus RRULE:FREQ=HOURLY and enabled=true.
The provisional 11-minute (660-second) write is crash insurance only and is superseded on every nonterminal close.
The final close-time RRULE update is the last scheduler mutation of the wake and survives live metadata reread.
CURRENT/ACTIVITY/HANDOFF follow the verified live final due; none may push an older provisional/stale due back to the scheduler.
No new automation, one-shot conversion, dtstart_offset_json, or retired-canonical reactivation occurs.
checkpointable_substeps: Record and verify the provisional full-VEVENT RRULE arm.
Advance stale active projections to the current authority epoch without using them to drive the scheduler.
Audit remaining control/state surfaces for stale schedule-writer semantics and remove or demote them where safe.

At nonterminal close, perform the final SAME MAIN full-VEVENT RRULE write to observed close + exactly 1 minute (60 seconds), live-verify, then copy that due to durable projections without any later schedule mutation.
early_finish_fallback: Continue removing stale projection semantics and redundant schedule-control assumptions while preserving the minimal live RRULE path.
